common.noConversion: Not added together: {currencies} are shown separately, never converted.
common.sandbox: Sandbox mode: payments, mandates and payouts are simulated. No money moves.

line.external_sales: Sales reported from an external till

warning.no_terms: No royalty terms apply to this location and currency. Add terms, then recalculate.
warning.external_sales_pending_review: An external sales report for this period is waiting for review.
warning.external_sales_excluded: External sales are not part of this location’s royalty basis.
warning.foreign: Payments in another currency ({amount}) are not included: statements never mix currencies.

royalties.title: Royalties
royalties.description: Close periods, check and approve statements, invoice franchisees and collect, in each location’s currency.
royalties.closeHint: Period: {frequency}. Each period ends at midnight in each location’s own time zone. Closing creates a statement for every franchised location.
royalties.closed: Period closed: {count, plural, one {# statement} other {# statements}} ready to check.
royalties.closedMissing: Period closed: {count, plural, one {# statement} other {# statements}}. {missing, plural, one {# location has} other {# locations have}} no terms yet.
royalties.noPeriodsBody: Close the last period to produce royalty statements.
royalties.invoicedAll: {count, plural, =0 {No invoices issued} one {# invoice issued} other {# invoices issued}}.
royalties.overdueSub: {count, plural, one {# overdue invoice} other {# overdue invoices}} · {amount}
royalties.dunningDone: Dunning done: {reminders} reminders, {lateFees} late fees, {retries} retries, {notices} final notices.

statement.recalculated: Statement recalculated from the latest sales.
statement.approved: Statement approved. It can now be invoiced.

dispute.title: Disputes
dispute.raiseHint: HQ finance reviews it before the statement is invoiced.

invoice.daysOverdue: {count, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
invoice.noMandate: No payment method on file: the franchisee needs to set up a debit or card.
invoice.collectFailed: The payment failed ({code}). Dunning will retry.
invoice.recordTitle: Record a payment received outside BranchHarbor

dunning.reminder: Reminder sent before the due date

sales.hqHint: Locations on an external till report their sales with evidence. Only accepted reports count towards royalties.
sales.submitTitle: Report sales from an external till
sales.submitHint: For sales that don’t go through BranchHarbor. Attach the till’s report (PDF, image, CSV or spreadsheet, up to 5 MB).
sales.evidenceHint: PDF, image, CSV or spreadsheet, up to 5 MB.
sales.submitted: Report sent. HQ finance will review it.

terms.hint: Terms are set per franchisee (owner group) or as the network default, per currency, with effective dates. A franchise agreement’s rates take priority when one exists.
terms.techFee: Technology fee per location per period ({currency})
terms.tierMarginal: Each band at its own rate
terms.tierWhole: All sales at the rate of the band reached
terms.graceDays: Grace days after the due date
terms.emptyBody: Add the network default terms for each currency your locations trade in.

settings.collectionBody: Franchisees pay into HQ’s own Stripe account by card or bank debit, with a mandate they accept in BranchHarbor. Money never sits with BranchHarbor.
settings.autoCollect: Collect automatically when an invoice is issued
settings.retryDays: Retry collection on days after the due date
settings.reminderDays: Reminder days before the due date
settings.taxBody: BranchHarbor adds no tax by itself. Add only the tax lines your accountant has confirmed, per country.

mine.title: Statements & invoices
mine.description: Your royalty statements, invoices, payment method and sales reports, for your locations only.
mine.noStatementsBody: Statements appear here when HQ closes a period.

method.intro: Invoices are collected from the method saved here on their due date. You can replace or revoke it at any time.
method.authorise: I authorise HQ to collect royalty, marketing fund and fee invoices for {group} in {currency} from this method on or after each due date, until I revoke it.
method.started: Authorisation recorded. Confirm the method to finish.

fund.title: Marketing fund
fund.description: Where the network’s marketing fund comes from and what it pays for, per currency.
fund.contributions: Contributions ({count, plural, one {# franchisee} other {# franchisees}})
fund.spendHint: Every spend needs its receipt and a campaign. Spend can’t exceed the fund balance in that currency.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.description: Payouts to each location’s bank, with fees, refunds and chargebacks, reconciled with payments and royalties.
payouts.synced: {count, plural, =0 {No new payouts} one {# payout updated} other {# payouts updated}}.
payouts.emptyBody: Sync payouts to load them from the payment provider.

recon.hint: For each location: what customers paid in BranchHarbor, what reached the bank, and the royalty statement and invoice for the same period.
recon.empty: Nothing to reconcile in this period

exports.title: Exports for accounting
exports.hint: CSV files to import into your accounting software. Xero and QuickBooks layouts are files only; nothing is sent to them.
exports.currencyHint: QuickBooks bank files need one currency.

reports.title: Finance reports
reports.description: Royalty revenue, collection and arrears per currency.
reports.collectionSub: {rate}% of {invoiced} invoiced · {onTime} of {paid} paid on time
